title: TimeToShare provenance entry
description: The one provenance entry of TimeToShare 0.2.0, shared by the statements of a manifest (`timetoshare.schema.json`, whose entries add the pair they are about, `property` and `value`), its flow-control elements and FlowMaps (whose entries are about the element itself and name no pair) and the rows of a MatchClaim table (its `provenance` column). It holds how an item was made (paradata: who stated it, when, how, by which service, on what basis, how closely it matches, a note) and who believes it (`beliefs`). Nothing in the format derives a truth value from the beliefs: one actor's belief leaves another's standing. One reading is fixed, for flow control alone: a flow-control element that some actor believes `false` is rejected and left out when a flow is computed. A person stating an item through an editor or a library is recorded with the belief `true`; a loader or a service records how the item was made and holds no belief. Every key is optional. Each actor holds at most one belief, which the TimeToShare validators check after the schema; a later belief of an actor replaces the earlier one.

stated_by.description: Who stated the item: persons, organisations or software, each an IRI or a reference.

method.description: How the item was made: `manual`, `reconciled`, `imported`, `inferred`, or an IRI.

service.description: The service the item was made with or taken from.

basis.description: The sources the item rests on.

match.description: How closely a reconciled value matches what was meant, as the SKOS mapping properties say.

beliefs.description: Who believes the item, each actor at most once.

Belief.description: One actor's belief in an item, since `date`: one of the strings `true` (the actor holds it true), `false` (the actor holds it false) or `unlikely`.

actor.description: Who holds the belief: a person or an organisation, an IRI or a reference.

date.description: When the actor stated the belief.

CalendarDate.description: A day written YYYY-MM-DD; that it is a day of the Gregorian calendar is checked after the schema.
